title.zh: 数据工作台与接口异常

brief.zh: 运营人员需要按组筛选记录并翻页。让筛选、页码、空态和错误态保持一致，制造A慢B快的请求顺序，确认旧响应不会覆盖当前结果。
brief.en: An operator needs filterable records with pagination. Keep the current filter and page consistent, handle empty/error states, and reject older asynchronous responses.

zh: 可运行工作台与组件说明
过滤/分页结果与契约一致
旧响应被取消或不覆盖新请求
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
An earlier request must not replace results for the new filter. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 快速改变筛选造成旧结果覆盖，应在测试中失败
failure.en: An earlier request must not replace results for the new filter.

en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 运营人员需要按组筛选记录并翻页。让筛选、页码、空态和错误态保持一致，制造A慢B快的请求顺序，确认旧响应不会覆盖当前结果。
快速改变筛选造成旧结果覆盖，应在测试中失败；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: An operator needs filterable records with pagination.
Reproduce this failure first: An earlier request must not replace results for the new filter.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
